language_task: Place the toys on the plate with no collisions.

However, subsequent low gripper movement displaces the plate and leaves the tan toy outside it (overhead_cam and wrist_cam, frames 1559–1588). At frame 1799, overhead_cam shows the pink and blue toys on the plate and the tan toy beside it. Thus the final arrangement visibly fails the task, rather than merely lacking confirmation; unwanted collisions and repeated failed attempts also occur. Selected visual checks limit exact boundary precision, particularly around the recovery near frame 360.
